scholarshipMetaData.subtitle: Scholarships
description: Applicant must: (a) be an international student; (b) have received a conditional or unconditional offer of admission to an eligible master's programme at the University of Auckland; and (c) have an Admissions GPE of at least 7.0.
Up to 25% of tuition fees for the first two semesters
